About

I'm a Manufacturing & Automation Design Engineer with 6.5+ years of end-to-end experience — from first sketch to production floor. My core domain is Special Purpose Machine design for high-volume, high-precision manufacturing, with deep hands-on expertise in relay assembly, automotive connectors & headers, EV busbar integration, and pouch cell battery assembly.

Currently Lead — Mechanical Design at Titan Engineering & Automation Ltd (TEAL), a TATA enterprise in Hosur, designing SPMs for global OEMs from RFQ to build. Previously at TE Connectivity (Pune) as Manufacturing Engineer & Project Launch Team Leader, where I owned complete program transfers — from global onboarding and supplier qualification through to PPAP sign-off and steady-state OEE. I've overseen 5 international project transfers, managed cross-functional teams of 8–12, and delivered measurable improvements in throughput, cost, and quality at every engagement.

What sets me apart is the combination of mechanical design depth — 900+ 2D/3D models, multi-axis mechanisms, custom pneumatic and servo architectures — and program-level ownership. I don't just design the machine. I deliver the outcome.
